rootText: Retirement No matter where you are in life, it’s never too early to prepare for retirement. Your golden years are the time for freedom, security, and fulfilment – start planning for a more secure tomorrow. Contact us Live Fully In Your Golden Years Focus on living your golden years and prioritise what matters the most to you. Protection MEDIUM PRIORITY In the event of unexpected circumstances such as critical illnesses, accidents or death, your nest egg might be impacted by rising healthcare costs. Your priority for protection: Adequate cover from age-related health issues and medical treatments that will last until demise. Additional cover for long-term care. Plan your protection Wealth MEDIUM PRIORITY To pursue passions, travel the world, and spend quality time with loved ones without financial worry, you’ll need sufficient finances. Your priority for wealth: Retirement savings and income. Legacy planning including a will and CPF nomination. Build your wealth Learn More About Your Needs Protection Wealth Protection Health needs may increase as you age – the sooner you get insured, the more peace of mind you’ll have. What you already have1 If you are a Singaporean or PR, you’re automatically covered by three national schemes: MediSave A national savings scheme which helps CPF members save for future medical expenses, especially during retirement. MediShield Life A health insurance for large hospital bills and selected outpatient treatment costs. CareShield Life Long-term care insurance scheme for financial support and monthly cash payouts in event of severe disability. What you may consider2 You might have insurance protection policies, but are you truly covered for health issues and increased risk of accidents that come with age? The key is ensuring you have enough coverage to avoid dipping into your retirement savings. You’ll need: Critical Illness Plan Integrated Shield Plan Personal Accident Plan You might also need to review your insurance plans to see if they remain affordable when you’re no longer drawing a salary. Why Act Now Health issues may increase as you age2. Healthcare and medical treatments should not deplete your retirement savings2. Connect with a Financial Representative for personalised coverage. Contact us Misconceptions? Let’s correct them. Check out some common misunderstandings about financial planning and their truths. It is okay not to disclose your existing medical condition. I am not eligible for insurance because I am too old or have a pre-existing condition. Having health insurance means all treatments are fully covered. Misconception: It is okay not to disclose your existing medical condition. Truth: It's best to be open about your pre-existing medical conditions. Hiding them could result in claim rejections or even a terminated plan if discovered. Having pre-existing conditions doesn’t mean you can’t get insured in Singapore; it just means there might be some extra considerations for coverage and premiums. Yes, I want an expert’s help Misconception: I am not eligible for insurance because I am too old or have a pre-existing condition. Truth: You can still purchase health and/or life insurance in Singapore, though some additional considerations will be factored in due to age or pre-existing conditions. There are specialised plans so it’s best to consult a Financial Representative to understand what’s best for your condition, age and financial goals! Yes, I want an expert’s help Misconception: Having health insurance means all treatments are fully covered. Truth: Not always. Policies can have limits, gaps, and exclusions. It's a good idea to review your coverage, spot any gaps, and consider extra insurance or add-ons based on your health and family history to avoid unexpected medical bills. Source: Health insurance terms: Know what you’re paying for, Moneysense Yes, I want an expert’s help Find The Right Plan Critical Illness Medical & Accident Prepare for your health gap years—the period when a critical illness diagnosis may require time away from work to focus on recovery for yourself or your loved ones. Be protected from the financial impact of serious conditions such as cancer, stroke, and heart attack, so you can recover with peace of mind and continue supporting your family in the event of a critical illness. PRUActive Protect A customisable critical illness insurance plan that can be built as you grow, providing coverage against recurring early stage critical illnesses and more. PRUCancer 360 An affordable cancer insurance plan that provides multi-stage coverage against all cancers. PRUEarly Stage Crisis Cover A plan that offers financial support right from the early stages of selected critical illnesses. All Critical Illness Plans Be protected against unforeseen medical expenses, rising healthcare costs or unexpected injuries with our suite of tailored products and supplementary plans. PRUShield and PRUExtra Comprehensive health insurance coverage to suit your budget and needs. PRUPersonal Accident Personal accident insurance to cover minor mishaps or unexpected injuries even when you’re overseas. Wealth Your golden years are the time to kick back and live the life you desire. In addition to securing your protection, planning for your goals, including legacy planning, is essential. Basics – what you should have A Plan For Monthly Payouts3 Choose from three CPF LIFE plans to fit your needs. Emergency Funds4,5 At least 3 – 6 months’ worth of expenses for rainy days. Legacy Planning4,5 A plan for a will, family trusts, life insurance, powers of attorney, and CPF nominations. Invest At Least 10% Of Take-Home Pay5 For retirement, if you are currently earning a steady income and not yet retired. What you may consider It pays to start planning for retirement early. To see if your nest egg is sufficient, consider the kind of lifestyle you want to lead, how long you expect to be in retirement, and what amount of income you desire. Here's how to find out if your savings will last6: Calculate Needs: Review your expenses before and during retirement. Assess Resources: Add your savings and any monthly payouts. Consider Inflation: Take into account inflation and your expected investment returns. Find The Gap: Subtract the needs from the resources. If the result is negative, you may find it challenging to maintain a comfortable retirement. More ways to bridge the gap4,5: Investment Or Savings Plans Tap Into Your Assets If you are 55 years old or above, explore monetising your property (Silver Housing Bonus, Lease Buyback Scheme, renting out room / flat). Spend Within Your Means Why Act Now More time to build good habits and grow your savings7. Age with purpose and dignity as lifespans get longer8. Maintain lifestyle amidst increased spending due to inflation9. Connect with a Financial Representative for personalised coverage. Contact us Misconceptions? Let’s correct them. Check out some common misunderstandings about financial planning and their truths. ILPs are a risky investment move. The older you get, the more you pay for ILP premiums. I will get better returns from investments other than life insurance. Misconception: ILPs are a risky investment move. Truth: Unlike some other insurance plans, ILPs don’t necessarily guarantee returns, which may lead them to being perceived as risky. However, understanding your own financial situation and goals and carefully evaluating the ILP and its sub-funds can help give you more confidence to invest. Yes, I want an expert’s help Misconception: The older you get, the more you pay for ILP premiums. Truth: The premiums paid for ILPs do not actually increase, but the insurance coverage charges generally increase as you age, meaning more investment units in your policy will be deducted to pay for the charges. Yes, I want an expert’s help Misconception: I will get better returns from investments other than life insurance. Truth: It really depends on your life goals. It's hard to guarantee returns from investments or life insurance policies, but having life insurance provides extra benefits like financial stability for you and your loved ones. It also encourages regular saving, which can be tough to maintain through active investing. Since returns can vary based on market conditions and personal choices, it's important to match your financial goals with the right savings method. Talking to a Financial Representative can help you make the best choice for your needs.
